page.notes: Faint marks in the left margin beside "Ætate" and "Inferiores", and a small mark in the right margin near the middle of the page, are not clearly printed text and are not transcribed. A mark after "communes." is uncertain and was left out. "nun[?]" in "vel nun ordinare" is doubtful; the scan may read "non" with a tilde. "otij[?]" is doubtful.
